[2026-10-30T18:06:37.892Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.78735
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T02:58:03.915Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.357841
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:00:09.106Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.761917
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

    FROM `documents` d

  [50] doc-11

[2026-10-31T03:00:20.260Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.477251
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d

  [50] doc-11

[2026-10-31T03:00:31.030Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.691187
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d

  [50] doc-11

[2026-10-31T03:00:41.608Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.24298
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d

      LIMIT 50

        LIMIT 50

    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id

  [50] doc-11

[2026-10-31T03:00:53.538Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.175783
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d

    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id

  [50] doc-11

[2026-10-31T03:01:04.691Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.448795
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [50] doc-11

[2026-10-31T03:01:08.095Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.307315
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d

  [50] doc-11

[2026-10-31T03:01:11.481Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.880117
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d

  [50] doc-11

[2026-10-31T03:01:14.721Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.509716
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d

  [50] doc-11

[2026-10-31T03:01:17.980Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 7.45081
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

    FROM `documents` d

  [50] doc-11

[2026-10-31T03:01:32.761Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.007479
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

    FROM `documents` d

             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (

      FROM (

        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [50] doc-11

[2026-10-31T03:02:37.321Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.264495
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:02:44.901Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.908646
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:02:52.645Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.282481
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:03:00.881Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.084493
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:03:08.875Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.276066
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:03:20.133Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.821787
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [50] doc-11

[2026-10-31T03:03:28.296Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.305019
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:03:36.031Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.932577
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:03:43.498Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.725851
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:03:51.426Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.107259
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:04:06.101Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.10009
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [50] doc-11

[2026-10-31T03:04:17.923Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.828826
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:04:29.653Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.001063
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (

             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (

      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [50] doc-11

[2026-10-31T03:04:40.685Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.246792
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

    FROM `documents` d

             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id

      FROM (

        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC

  [50] doc-11

[2026-10-31T03:04:51.313Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.946524
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (

             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [50] doc-11

[2026-10-31T03:05:00.114Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.080308
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [50] doc-11

[2026-10-31T03:05:02.746Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.915166
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:05:05.422Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.03498
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:05:08.028Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.184159
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:05:10.670Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.534536
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:09:11.144Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 7.587339
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:09:22.348Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.290817
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [50] doc-11

[2026-10-31T03:09:35.031Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.32374
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:09:46.993Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.387569
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:09:59.762Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.900115
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:11:44.282Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.540573
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:12:21.806Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.976161
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:12:33.886Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.100951
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:12:45.437Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.251362
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:12:56.855Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.975383
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:13:08.260Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.18273
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:13:19.332Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 7.531443
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:13:22.680Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 11.004697
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:13:26.018Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.965986
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:13:29.313Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.343062
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:13:32.597Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.877809
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:13:47.499Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.428652
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:13:58.774Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.250311
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:14:10.002Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.030759
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:14:21.254Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.288817
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:14:32.014Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.071351
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:14:42.121Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.423152
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:14:50.562Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.811715
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5
