[2026-10-31T03:14:57.993Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.653226
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:15:05.449Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.073436
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:15:12.881Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.078379
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:15:22.918Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.695362
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:15:30.502Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.208671
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:15:37.813Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.94429
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:15:45.309Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.532527
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:15:52.520Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.491625
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:16:07.279Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.008166
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:16:18.409Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.417023
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:16:29.242Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.234071
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:16:40.069Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.778018
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:16:50.810Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.998823
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:16:59.270Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.211055
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (

      FROM (

        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC

[2026-10-31T03:17:01.977Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.446246
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`

    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id

        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL

[2026-10-31T03:17:04.697Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.378046
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`

    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id

        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL

[2026-10-31T03:17:07.543Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.694265
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`

    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (

        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC

[2026-10-31T03:17:10.579Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.617506
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r

    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id

        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL

[2026-10-31T03:17:29.656Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 7.859313
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:17:40.878Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.473492
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:17:52.119Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 7.303587
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:18:03.946Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.765561
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:18:16.621Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.238001
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:18:28.403Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.289016
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:18:31.820Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 7.159038
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:18:35.338Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.199552
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:18:38.780Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.376511
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:18:42.041Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.170201
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:18:56.422Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.971463
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:19:07.749Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.596984
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:19:18.750Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.582644
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:19:29.674Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.745774
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:19:40.801Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.799816
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:19:51.618Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.985812
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:19:59.381Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.210097
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:20:06.917Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.224834
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:20:14.789Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.809026
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:20:22.857Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.324725
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5
