SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:20:34.677Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.224261
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:20:43.309Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.305566
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:20:52.012Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.48219
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:20:59.769Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.627308
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:20:59.964Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.426177

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:21:08.026Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.610926
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:21:22.583Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 7.03429
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:21:33.695Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.447999
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:21:44.565Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.765808
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:21:55.136Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.233593
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:22:06.301Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.379925
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

[2026-10-31T03:22:06.501Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:22:16.146Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 6.377446
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`

    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (

        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC

[2026-10-31T03:22:18.696Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 5.201853
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:22:21.261Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.659371
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`

      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (

        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC

[2026-10-31T03:22:23.929Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.587524
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

  [55] doc-12

[2026-10-31T03:22:26.517Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 4.690953
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC

        LIMIT 50

    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id

[2026-10-31T03:24:05.353Z] label=hybrid
note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合
duration_ms: 8.328522
rows: 5
--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5

note: 向量 + 全文混合检索：一条 SQL，RRF 融合

--- SQL ---
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content, d.metadata,
           COALESCE(ft.r, 0) AS fulltext_rank,
           COALESCE(vv.r, 0) AS vector_rank,
           ROUND(
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + ft.r), 0) +
             COALESCE(1.0 / (60 + vv.r), 0)
           , 6) AS hybrid_score
    FROM `documents` d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC
             ) AS r
      FROM `documents`
      WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (? IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
      LIMIT 50
    ) ft ON ft.id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?)) AS r
      FROM (
        SELECT id, embedding FROM `documents`
        ORDER BY cosine_distance(embedding, ?) APPROXIMATE
        LIMIT 50
      ) z
    ) vv ON vv.id = d.id
    WHERE ft.id IS NOT NULL OR vv.id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY hybrid_score DESC
    LIMIT 5
